div.div: وَقُورٌ (S, A, K) and ↓ وَقَارٌ , and ↓ وَقُرٌ , (K,) or ↓ وَقَرٌ , (L,) and ↓ مُتَوَقِّرٌ , (TA,) Grave; staid; sedate; calm: applied to a man: (S, A, K, TA:) and the first applied also to a woman: (K:) pl. of the first, وُقُرٌ, (A, TA,) applied to men, (A,) and to women. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
